name: Dana Nessel
stance: Wants Congress to impose federal safety testing, incident response and international limits on harmful superintelligence without preempting states.

statements.text: Congress needs to exercise its oversight duty and create guardrails for this technology before these powerful systems cause irreparable harm to our global infrastructure.
As AI continues to grow and evolve, states must have the ability to act and protect their residents,
No company should be putting tools into the public’s hands that deliberately make it easier to sexually exploit others,

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
